title: Calming Sleep-Sound Mixer — Gemini model variant
description: A developer-operated Gemini rerun of the canonical Calming Sleep-Sound Mixer brief, preserved as an auditable PathForge Labs model variant rather than a community fork.

comparison_basis.opening_prompt_exact: Build me a calming sleep-sound mixer I can save as one file and open in my browser. I want adjustable rain, fan, and brown-noise layers that are generated in the page instead of streamed, a few useful presets, and a sleep timer that fades out gently. It should feel reassuring and simple enough to use in the dark.
acceptance_criteria: Produce one complete self-contained HTML file.
Generate rain, fan, and brown-noise audio locally in the browser without streamed or bundled audio.
Provide independent layer controls plus a clearly labeled overall master-volume control.
Provide at least three genuinely distinct presets.
Provide a sleep timer with visible state, a gentle fade, and a truthful finished or cancelled state.
Start audio only from a user gesture and keep play, pause, and resume state truthful.
Operate offline with no external APIs, hosted generation, CDNs, remote fonts, scripts, stylesheets, or fragile dependencies.
Avoid unsafe HTML sinks, eval-like execution, inline event handlers, modal dialogs, and deprecated clipboard handling.
Avoid page-level horizontal overflow at 390 by 844 and at desktop width.
Keep essential controls visible and reachable while preserving exact prompt, response, and artifact evidence.
comparison_basis.adaptive_repair_policy: Preserve and score the first artifact. Continue only when verification proves a concrete defect or a source-capture failure; use the same source session and model; name the observed defect in ordinary language; preserve every real artifact version; stop as soon as the artifact passes; allow no more than three total prompts except for documented truncation or mechanical capture failure.
comparison_basis.independence_note: Gemini received the invariant brief in a fresh session and was not shown the historical implementation, screenshots, source code, or another provider's output.

agent_notes: Model settings: Gemini web; Pro mode.
PathForge Labs provenance: developer-operated comparison run; not a user, community fork, vote, bookmark, or engagement event.
Prompt count: 3. Two verification-driven repairs corrected a playback-state recursion defect, added a needed master control and safe listeners, then fixed stale pre-play percentage labels.
All three real artifact versions are preserved under public/artifacts. The third artifact is the default selectable version for this model run.
Final verification passed static safety, JavaScript parsing, pre-play labels, start/stop, presets, timer, desktop layout, and measured 390x844 no-overflow checks.

artifact_version_notes.disposition: Preserved first response; not the default because verification found playback-state recursion and acceptance/safety gaps.
Preserved repair; not the default because verification found stale percentage labels before playback.
Final verified artifact and default Gemini version.

verification_notes: The final artifact's single inline script parsed successfully.
Static scan found no external URL, remote dependency, fetch, XHR, WebSocket, unsafe HTML sink, eval-like execution, inline handler, document.write, modal API, or deprecated clipboard handling.

Before playback, master and layer percentage labels updated truthfully. Start and Stop returned to coherent states. A 15-minute timer displayed a truthful armed state. Stormy applied the intended 10/80/20 layer values and started playback.

At 390x844 the document and body stayed within 390 pixels; the main container measured 350 pixels with no page-level horizontal overflow. Full-page visual inspection found a polished and reachable mobile interface.
The Chrome verification bridge emitted a synthetic image-fetch message beyond the artifact source; the artifact contains no image or fetch code.

steps.title: Build the invariant sleep-sound mixer brief
steps.prompt_exact: Build me a calming sleep-sound mixer I can save as one file and open in my browser. I want adjustable rain, fan, and brown-noise layers that are generated in the page instead of streamed, a few useful presets, and a sleep timer that fades out gently. It should feel reassuring and simple enough to use in the dark.
steps.response_summary: Gemini produced the first complete one-file Sleep Sound Mixer artifact.
steps.notes: Preserved as the unmodified first artifact. Verification found a playback-state recursion bug, no master control, and inline event handlers.

steps.title: Repair playback state and acceptance gaps
steps.prompt_exact: I tested the saved file and found one real playback-state bug: from the initial all-zero state, pressing Start loads the default preset but leaves the internal state out of sync, so pressing Stop still shows Stop instead of returning to Start. Please fix that without changing the basic design. While you are repairing it, add a master-volume slider (a sleep mixer needs one), replace the inline onclick attributes with normal event listeners, and keep the existing rain/fan/brown controls, presets, local audio generation, gentle timer fade, and 390px no-overflow layout. Return the complete updated self-contained HTML in one code block.
steps.response_summary: Gemini repaired playback state, added a master control, and replaced inline handlers.
steps.continuation_reason: Verification-proven defect: starting from all-zero state left playback state out of sync; master control and safe listener requirements were also unmet.
steps.notes: Preserved first repair. Verification then found stale percentage labels before AudioContext initialization.

steps.title: Repair pre-play control labels
steps.prompt_exact: I tested the updated file before pressing Start and found one last concrete state defect: moving the master or any layer slider changes the knob, but its percentage label stays stale because updateMasterVolume and updateVolumes return before the AudioContext exists. Please make every label update immediately before playback, while only applying gain changes when the audio nodes actually exist. Keep the repaired start/stop flow, master control, presets, timer, offline behavior, and layout unchanged, and return the complete updated self-contained HTML again.
steps.response_summary: Gemini made all percentage labels update before playback without touching unavailable audio nodes.
steps.continuation_reason: Verification-proven defect: moving master or layer controls before Start changed the knob but left the displayed percentage stale.
steps.notes: Final verified production artifact. The preferred three-prompt cap was reached and no additional repair was warranted.
